title: Packaging Design in Tashkent from $500
description: Packaging design in Tashkent: concept, labels and boxes, a range for every flavour and size, print-ready files. Advanced from $500, All in one from $1,900.
lead: OneBranding designs packaging that stands out on the shelf and makes the product's value clear: labels, boxes and whole product ranges, ready for print. Packaging design starts at $500 (Advanced) and $1,900 (All in one).
intro: Packaging is where the brand meets the buyer. In a few seconds on the shelf, a pack has to say what the product is, why it is worth its price and which brand stands behind it. We start with the category: how competitors look, what buyers expect and where your product can stand apart. The design is then built on your brand identity, so the pack and the brand speak with one voice.

We design new packaging and redesign existing packs, from a single label to a range with several flavours, sizes or lines. Every layout is prepared for production on your printer's dieline, with room for the composition, barcode and other mandatory details you provide. We work with producers in Uzbekistan and abroad, in Uzbek, Russian and English, remotely or at our office in Tashkent.

includes.title: What packaging design includes
items: Category research and a look at competitors on the shelf
Design of the main label, box or pack
Adaptation to every flavour, size and line
Placement of composition, barcode and mandatory details
3D mock-ups to see the pack before print

steps.name: Brief and research
steps.text: We learn the product, the buyer and the price segment, and study how competitors look on the shelf.

steps.name: Concept
steps.text: We propose packaging directions built on your brand and agree on one with you.

steps.name: Design and range
steps.text: We design the main pack, then adapt it to every flavour, size or line.

steps.name: Refinement
steps.text: Each stage includes rounds of revisions with your feedback; you approve it before we move on.

steps.name: Files for print
steps.text: We lay the design out on the printer's dieline and hand over print-ready and source files.

items.q: How much does packaging design cost in Tashkent?
items.a: Packaging design starts at $500 for the Advanced package and $1,900 for All in one. The final price depends on the number of products and versions in the range and is agreed after the brief.

items.q: Do you design only labels or whole boxes too?
items.a: Both. We design labels, boxes, bags, bottles, tubes and other formats, as well as whole ranges where several products have to look like one family on the shelf.

items.q: Can you redesign our existing packaging?
items.a: Yes. We look at what buyers already recognise in your current pack, keep it where it still works and renew the rest, so regular customers can still find the product on the shelf.

items.q: Will the files be ready for the printer?
items.a: Yes. We lay out the design on the dieline your printer provides and hand over print-ready files in the formats they ask for, together with the editable source files.

items.q: Do I need a brand identity before packaging?
items.a: It helps, because packaging should look like the rest of your brand. If you don't have an identity yet, we can develop it together with the packaging as part of a branding project.

cta.title: Tell us about your product
cta.text: Fill in the brief and we will come back with a proposal: scope, timeline and price.
